name: Centre for Innovation, Incubation and Entrepreneurship (CIIE) / IIT ISM Technology Innovation Hub (TEXMiN)
description: Technology Innovation Hub setup under NM-ICPS focusing on mining and exploration technologies, cyber-physical systems, and cleantech.
capabilities: Seed funding, IP protection, prototyping lab access, commercialization mentoring, GPU computing clusters.

name: Science and Technology Entrepreneurs' Park (STEP-BIT Mesra)
description: Pioneering DST-supported Technology Business Incubator established in 1987 supporting hardware, geospatial, and IT startups.
capabilities: Co-working space, electronics test benches, pilot manufacturing, angel network linkages, fabrication workshops.

name: NIT Jamshedpur Institution's Innovation Council (IIC)
description: Ministry of Education innovation council driving student ideation, hackathons, and hardware proof-of-concept development.
capabilities: Pre-incubation mentorship, proof-of-concept grants, regional industry problem matchmaking, patent filing assistance.

name: BIT Sindri Innovation & Incubation Cell (BIIC)
description: State-supported innovation unit facilitating student engineering prototypes in heavy industry, cleantech, and rural development.
capabilities: Makerspace, mechanical lathe and welding bays, electrical test benches, alumni mentorship.

name: BAU Agri-Business Incubation Centre (BAU-ABIC)
description: RKVY-RAFTAAR recognized agri-incubator supporting agronomy, organic processing, biocontrol, and farmer-producer ventures.
capabilities: Pilot agricultural field trials, tissue culture labs, bio-formulation testing, seed capital grants, FPO linkages.

name: Atal Bihari Vajpayee Centre for Public Policy & Innovation (ABVCPPI)
description: Policy and social innovation think-tank fostering social ventures, rural business models, and governance pilots.
capabilities: Business model validation, public-private partnership advisory, impact evaluation frameworks, venture scaling.

name: IIIT Ranchi Technology Incubation & Innovation Centre
description: Hub promoting early-stage deep-tech startups working on AI, vernacular NLP, smart embedded devices, and robotics.
capabilities: Cloud compute credits, GPU server access, hardware design test kits, patent mentorship.

name: CUJ Innovation and Incubation Council (CUJ-IIC)
description: MoE IIC unit incubating tribal grassroots innovations, bio-energy projects, and eco-friendly products.
capabilities: Ideation bootcamps, green product prototyping, tribal artisan product design, academic mentoring.
